title: The Jacobson property for spectra and open covers
statement: (1) Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $\operatorname{Spec}R$ be its affine spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then every prime ideal of $R$ is the intersection of the maximal ideals containing it if and only if, for every closed subset $Z\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}R$, the points whose singleton is closed in $\operatorname{Spec}R$ and which lie in $Z$ are dense in $Z$. (2) Let $X$ be a topological space and $(V_i)_{i\in I}$ an open cover of $X$. The closed points of $X$ are dense in every closed subset of $X$ if and only if, for every $i$, the closed points of the subspace $V_i$ are dense in every closed subset of $V_i$. Here a closed point is a point whose singleton is closed in the indicated space. The index set $I$ can be infinite or empty.
